new_libraries.name: AmelTech Labs Bot
new_libraries.author: AmelTech Labs
new_libraries.sentence: Offline ESP32 chatbot with knowledge engine, calculator, sensor support and hardware diagnostics.
new_libraries.paragraph: It provides natural-language question answering, a built-in knowledge base, fuzzy matching, mathematical calculations, DHT sensor analysis, persistent user memory, serial training, hardware telemetry and health diagnostics.

library.name: BlueGraysIoT
library.author: Yunus Emre Eke <info@bluegrays.com>
library.sentence: Control ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico W boards from the BlueGrays app over a secure WebSocket.
library.paragraph: Switches, sliders, colors and live sensor values with charts in the BlueGrays mobile app. TLS with bundled root certificates, automatic Wi-Fi and server reconnects, rate limiting and state restore after a power cut. The BlueGrays app generates the code. The device key travels only in the connection header and is never printed.
